Bug Title: Missing shear modulus Gs fallback in designer causes crash for database steel grades
Reproduction Steps: 1. Configure standard bridge with steel grade 'E 350A' or 'E 250'. 2. Execute bridge.design() without custom Gs.
Expected Behavior: Gs automatically derived from Es and Poisson ratio via isotropic elasticity: Gs = Es / [2(1+nu)]
Actual Behavior: Raises ValueError: Gs is not set for grade 'E 350A'. Pipeline crashes completely.
Root Cause: SQLite database Intg_osdag.sqlite lacks Gs column. BridgeConfig required KEY_MATERIAL_GIRDER_G which is only present in Custom steel mode.
Suggested Fix: Calculate Gs = Es / (2.0 * (1.0 + nu)) as fallback when KEY_MATERIAL_GIRDER_G is missing.

Bug Title: Deck concrete fck/fctm/Ecm resolution failure for standard concrete grades
Reproduction Steps: 1. Select standard concrete grade 'M35' from basic inputs dropdown. 2. Execute bridge.design() without opening custom material dialog.
Expected Behavior: Designer extracts fck; fctm; and Ecm from bridge.material_props.concrete_prop resolved by backend.
Actual Behavior: Raises ValueError: 'material.deck.fck' is required but was not found in 'input_dict'.
Root Cause: BridgeConfig expected explicit sub-keys in input_dict. Standard selection only populates KEY_DECK_CONCRETE_GRADE_BASIC in input_dict.
Suggested Fix: Retrieve fck; fctm; and Ecm from bridge.material_props.concrete_prop when sub-keys are absent.
